reviews.text:
Time for a big compliment to the team at Sterkliniek Veterinarians.

No matter what is wrong with your pet, whether minor or major suffering, the assistants and veterinarians are always dedicated and friendly. You entrust your animal friend to these people. Keep up the good work, you are the best!

The advice I receive from all technicians is prompt, honest, thorough, and thoughtful. I’ve recently adopted my first cat and he is a senior. I’ve been quite anxious about a few things and have asked for some advice about his diet, sudden sickness, dental care, over grooming, and an abrasion. I have asked some questions via email and the technicians gave me guidance on monitoring him at home to avoid travel stress for my cat, or helped me to assess whether I should bring him in for a consult. My choice and decision was always supported and never judged negatively. Virtual responses are  always prompt and  thorough. My first in-person consult with Drs. Nouws was highly educational and she took the time to thoroughly and gently exam my cat, explain her observations, assess my options for my sick cat, and review all of the data on the laboratory results. I felt supported, understood, and involved by her throughout the process and it was a very affirming first-consult as a new pet owner. Scheduling appointments in general is easy, even for short notice appointments. I can tell that they genuinely care a lot about holistic health; physical, mental, social/ emotional. I also appreciate the ease of communication in English and they are also patient when I practice my Dutch with them.

I went here for a deworming tablet because we are going on holiday to England. I was inside for five minutes and had to pay 80 euros. I think that is a lot of money for a pill and a five-minute consultation that they automatically include (checking ears and listening to heartbeat, nothing more). After 6 minutes, I was outside again.
Can't this be cheaper?? This doesn't feel right!!

Response to the owner:

Thanks for the response. However, I still find it strange and unnecessary to have to book a consultation when I ask for a course of deworming. If I go to the GP for an earache, my whole body is examined then too. Certainly not if this has already happened recently. Also, if I were to come with my son or daughter to get vaccinated, I wouldn't get a consultation included that I didn't ask for. I have now paid 20 euros for what I came for and 60 for something I didn't ask for, and which lasted a few minutes. It was really just holding ears up to listen to heartbeat. I would find it pleasant and fair if I could get the 60 euros refunded.

Response to comment:

An investigation was not necessary. After all, this already happened at the other branch four weeks ago. That is also recorded in your system.

Dr. Winius is a wonderful veterinarian and the friendly veterinary staff! I've been a loyal customer for years and always receive excellent care. They stay informed about my animals' well-being and share the latest treatment tips. They specialize in stress-free treatment, which is great for both the animal and the owner. Everyone receives attention. That takes time, and time is money, but you can also call for a consultation at no extra cost—a great deal.

We’re absolutely delighted with this clinic! Everyone from the front desk and vets, is always incredibly friendly, caring, and professional. It’s clear how much they love animals and genuinely care about their patients. I tend to be quite anxious about our cat, Mewton, but they always take the time to answer all my questions and emails with patience and kindness. The service is excellent, appointments are never rushed.
We couldn’t be happier with their care and highly recommend their clinic 100%!

What a terrible vet! Truly terrible people! Overly commercially trained and with terrible judgment! They should be ashamed of how they "operate"! They wanted to put my cat to sleep because they didn't know what to do with him. A day later, I had him back on his feet. This vet only causes more harm to your pet. Please find a different profession! Safe your pet and do not go here.

Great vets who really take their time and are extremely helpful. There's always time for phone contact if needed, even on days when the clinic is closed. I always find it professional and pleasant here, and the care they provide is excellent. The senior cat is treated very calmly and well. The contact is very pleasant and the consultation is excellent before any treatment (the cost is stated upfront, and you can, of course, ask about it). I really appreciate this clinic and recommend it!
Friendly staff and received excellent service. It's great that they are also open on Saturdays!
Really friendly staff, helpful and good vets
Mrs. Cardoso is a sweet veterinarian who trimmed the teeth and nails of my 8-year-old rabbit Flap.

Fantastic, kind people. I can always call for advice, and this is the nicest vet I've ever been to. She never tries to upsell, but is very genuine. I regularly visit, and even my dog ​​always wants to come in because he always has good experiences (and gets treats, haha).
Terrible. Paid 154 euros for 2 kittens and they are trying to make you pay more money, not normal.

A great place for our fearful doggo, they are very patient and kind, know how to approach an animal in a way that creates a good experience for everyone involved. Always super helpful too! Very much recommended.
